lessons: Parse categories at the last underscore; instance suffixes are not persistent tracking identities.
Use perceived basket orientation and dimensions for containment, footprint margins, and release-site alternatives.
The supplied manual intervention supports testing offset endpoints, not assuming their feasibility or treating that evidence as autonomous improvement.
Basket-center endpoints and higher clearance repeatedly received no-path responses. Test bounded inset endpoints while empty, including the parent's modest lower release alternative.
Complete one category's available work before interleaving other categories; individual transfers do not establish a separated group.
Explicitly open both grippers before manipulation and release the carrying gripper at the destination.
Scene heights are nominal planes. Height changes, disappearance, and suffix continuity do not verify grasp or delivery.
Only explicit no_collision_free_path responses establish zero execution. Uncertain exceptions stop manipulation without automatic release.
After a rejected carrying motion, a bounded rollback may release only at the original supported source, never at an arbitrary failure location.
A commanded release reservation is a spacing precaution, not a successful-delivery record.
The interface supplies neither a home primitive nor a guaranteed initial Cartesian pose. A source-hover retreat cannot be called homing.

rationale: This proposal addresses the recorded endpoint failures by checking geometry-clipped, offset release poses with an empty gripper before committing to a grasp. It retains modest source clearance, prioritizes category completion, explicitly opens both grippers, and permits bounded reconsideration of objects still perceived outside their assigned basket. Explicit carrying-motion rejections allow only source-supported rollback; uncertain execution stops immediately. RPC and motion counters bound execution but cannot certify the unobservable remaining native-step budget. The policy does not infer delivery from perception artifacts or claim restoration of initial end poses. Independent evaluation determines physical delivery, partial credit, and full success.
